camel_example: aliyun quickbi-public QueryDataService --region cn-hangzhou --ApiId f4cc43bc3000 --version 2022-01-01 --method POST --force
description_en: Calls an API created in Data Service
description_zh: 对数据服务中已创建的API进行调用
name: QueryDataService

parameters.help_en: The ID of the API in Data Service. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144980.html
parameters.name: api_id

parameters.help_en:
The query conditions for Data Service, passed in key-value pairs. The value is a string of the map type. The key is the name of the request parameter, and the value is the value of the request parameter. Keys and values must appear in pairs.

Note:

When the operator of a request parameter is set to enumeration filter, the value can contain multiple values. In this case, the value must be a JSON-formatted list. Example: `area=["East China","North China","South China"]`     

For dates, different input formats are provided based on the type:

    - Year: 2019

    - Quarter: 2019Q1

    - Month: 201901 (including the leading zero)
    
    - Week: 2019-52

    - Day: 20190101

    - Hour: 14:00:00 (minutes and seconds are 00)
    
    - Minute: 14:12:00 (seconds are 00)

    - Second: 14:34:34
parameters.help_zh:
数据服务的查询条件，以Key和Value的形式传入。map类型的字符串。其中，Key为请求参数的参数名，Value为请求参数的参数值。Key和Value必须成对出现。

说明：

请求参数的操作符设置为枚举筛选时支持value包含多个值，此时value值的格式是JSON形式的List。例如： `area=["华东","华北","华南"] `     

对于日期，根据类型不同，提供不同的入参格式：

    - 年：2019

    - 季：2019Q1

    - 月：201901  （携带0）
    
    - 周：2019-52

    - 日：20190101

    - 时：14:00:00 （分、秒为00）
    
    - 分：14:12:00 （秒为00）

    - 秒：14:34:34
parameters.name: conditions

parameters.help_en: The list of return parameter names. The value is a string of the list type
parameters.help_zh: 返回参数的参数名列表，List 类型字符串
parameters.name: return_fields

Result.description_en: The query result returned by the API

Aggregator.description_en: The aggregation operator. This field is available only for measure fields, such as SUM, AVG, and MAX
Aggregator.description_zh: 聚合操作符。度量字段才会有，例如SUM、AVG和MAX

Column.description_en: The field name, which corresponds to the physical table field name
Column.description_zh: 字段名，对应物理表字段名

DataType.description_en: The data type of the field. Common values include number, string, date, datetime, time, and geographic
DataType.description_zh:
字段的数据类型。一般有
number、string、date、datetime、time、geographic

Granularity.description_en:
The granularity of the dimension field. This field is returned only when the requested field is a date dimension or geographic dimension field. Valid values:

Date granularity: yearRegion (year), monthRegion (month), weekRegion (week), dayRegion (day), hourRegion (hour), minRegion (minute), and secRegion (second).

Geographic granularity: COUNTRY (country level), PROVINCE (province level), CITY (city level), XIAN (district/county level), and REGION (region level)
Granularity.description_zh:
维度字段的粒度。
当请求字段为日期维度或地理维度字段，才会返回该字段，取值范围：

日期粒度：yearRegion（年）、 monthRegion（月）、weekRegion（周）、dayRegion（日）、hourRegion（时）、minRegion（分）、secRegion（秒）

地理信息粒度：COUNTRY（国际级）、PROVINCE（省级）、CITY（市级）、XIAN（区县）、REGION（区域）

Label.description_en: The alias of the field, which is the key of the map data row in the Values result parameter
Label.description_zh: 字段别名，结果参数values中map数据行的key

Type.description_en: The field type, which is used to distinguish whether the field is a dimension or a measure
Type.description_zh: 字段类型，用于区分是字段类型为维度或度量字段

Sql.description_en: The SQL statement of the query request
Sql.example: SELECT COMPANY_T_1_.`area` AS D_AREA_2_, COMPANY_T_1_.`city` AS D_CITY_3_, SUM(COMPANY_T_1_.`profit_amt`) AS D_PROFIT_4_ FROM `quickbi_test`.`company_sales_record_copy` AS COMPANY_T_1_ WHERE COMPANY_T_1_.`area` LIKE '%华东%' GROUP BY COMPANY_T_1_.`area`, COMPANY_T_1_.`city` HAVING SUM(COMPANY_T_1_.`order_amt`) > 1 LIMIT 0, 10

items.description_en:
The rows and columns of the returned data.

This parameter is of the List<Map> structure, where each map represents a row of data. The keys in the map correspond to the Label field in Headers
items.description_zh:
返回数据的行和列。

此参数为List<Map>结构，每个Map即一行数据。其中Map中的Key对应 Headers#Label字段

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:

true: The request is successful.

false: The request fails
Success.description_zh:
是否请求成功。取值范围：

true：请求成功

false：请求失败
